pr_body:
ChangeReplicas may return an error when there is an in-flight snapshot for a learner Replica. This is retriable error, so this commit makes the test to ignore it and retry.

Fixes #91121
Epic: none
Release note: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/95212)

issue_context.title: kvserver: TestRemovePlaceholderRace is flaky
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

client_raft_test.go:2878: cannot remove learner while snapshot is in flight
**To Reproduce**

Stress the test


Jira issue: CRDB-21112
comments:
```
./dev test pkg/kv/kvserver:kvserver_test --filter=TestRemovePlaceholderRace --stress
...
32479 runs so far, 0 failures, over 4h4m40s
```

Maybe need to run it in gceworker, same way as this flake was [discovered](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/89632#issuecomment-1288443983).

review_comments: Should this just be part of `IsRetriableReplicationChangeError`?

I think that could make sense. The only non-test caller is `executeAdminCommandWithDescriptor`, which I think would want to retry replication change errors as well. However, let's submit a follow-up PR for that, so that this is trivially backportable.
